description: This file defines a PHP trait named EndpointExceptionTrait which provides methods to generate and throw various custom exceptions related to API error handling, such as BadRequestException, NotImplementedException, RecordNotFoundException, and ForbiddenException. It also contains utility methods for validation and exception throwing based on entity existence and input parameters.

methods.name: getBadRequestException
methods.description: Creates a new BadRequestException with a provided message or default message.

methods.name: getNotImplementedException
methods.description: Creates a new NotImplementedException with a provided message or default message.

methods.name: getRecordNotFoundException
methods.description: Creates a new RecordNotFoundException with a provided message or default message.

methods.name: getForbiddenException
methods.description: Creates a new ForbiddenException with a provided message or default message.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfNotExist
methods.description: Checks if an entity exists and matches a class; throws a RecordNotFoundException if not.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfEmptyIds
methods.description: Checks if an array of entity IDs is empty and throws a RecordNotFoundException if so.

methods.name: getInvalidParamException
methods.description: Creates an InvalidParamException with details about invalid parameters.
